concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-local-payment-methods-grabpay]] - collected unversioned GrabPay method notice for limited-release and applicability retrieval, preserving its unresolved seller-country conflict
warnings: The notice says sellers must be in Singapore, while its applicability table says seller countries are Global; the snapshot does not resolve the conflict.
The page contains no SDK, platform, environment, initiation, notification, settlement or funding procedure; do not inherit one from sibling Local Payment Method guides.
